Privacy Policy

VatSnap is a static calculator. There is nothing to sign up for, and nothing to track you with. Last updated: September 2026.

Short version

We do not collect, store, or sell personal data. Calculations happen entirely in your browser — the prices you type never leave your device.

What we don't collect

  • No accounts, no names, no email addresses.
  • No advertising trackers, no third-party cookies.
  • No server-side storage — there is no database behind this site.

Analytics

We use privacy-friendly, aggregate measurement (Google Analytics) to see which pages are visited, so we know what to improve. It does not track the prices you type into the calculator — those never leave your device. You can block it with any content blocker and the site keeps working.

What stays on your device

Your theme preference (light/dark) is saved in your browser's localStorage under the key vatsnap-theme so the site remembers it. Nothing else is stored, and clearing site data removes it. No cookies are set by VatSnap itself.

Hosting & infrastructure

VatSnap is hosted on Cloudflare (Workers static assets). Like any host, Cloudflare may process basic technical logs (e.g. IP address, requested URL, timestamps) to deliver pages securely and prevent abuse. We do not have access to per-visitor analytics beyond what Cloudflare provides by default, and we do not combine any such data with anything else — because there is nothing else.

Fonts

The site loads fonts from Google Fonts. When your browser fetches them, Google receives a standard web request (similar to loading any file from a CDN). If you prefer, you can block third-party font requests — the site still works with system fonts.

Embedded widget

If you embed the VatSnap widget (/embed/) on your own site, the same rules apply: the widget runs client-side and sends nothing back to us.

Contact

If you email us, we will only use your address to reply. See our Contact page.

Changes

If this policy ever changes, the updated version will be posted here with a new "last updated" date.

VatSnap is a free, unofficial EU VAT rate calculator for small online sellers. Rates come from the European Commission TEDB. Guidance only.
